feed.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugins — Curated List · Awesome DSH Plugin

entry.title: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-session-hotkeys
entry.summary: Keyboard session management for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next), keyboard model switching, alternate send, archive confirmation, and focus-search, with every binding rebindable via Windows/macOS presets.

entry.title: Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist
entry.summary: AI piano performance: ask the agent to play a piece on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples and a playable 88-key keyboard.

entry.title: dsh-blue/blue
entry.summary: An interactive full-screen terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming Markdown transcripts, tool-call cards, an approval panel, session management, and hot theme switching — every component is a hot-pluggable plugin tree.

entry.title: FuqiangCraft/dsh-desktop
entry.summary: Adds desktop notifications, a multi-agent visualization canvas, and an optional screen-capture tool to DSH.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-auto-translate
entry.summary: Auto-translates English replies inline below the original text, with Chinese annotations for tool calls; translation goes through an independent provider request and never enters the session context.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-commander
entry.summary: Commander mode for DSH Web: inject protocol briefs into the session title bar, parse task blocks from model replies and auto-execute them, separating strategy from execution; activated via a badge button.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-token-viewer
entry.summary: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero with cache-hit rate, trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak pricing, per-project stats, and account balance.

entry.title: stephenlzc/dsh-swarm-panel#dsh-swarm-plugin
entry.summary: Conversation Flow observability for DeepSeek Harness swarms, with topology, routed-message inspection, HITL pauses, Live follow, and child-session navigation.

entry.title: taxueseek/dsh-files
entry.summary: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.

entry.title: imkelt/DSH-RAG
entry.summary: Local knowledge bases for DSH Web with multi-directory incremental indexing, BM25 and SiliconFlow hybrid retrieval, and source cards that locate and open original files.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-context-compressor
entry.summary: Context compression for small models: compresses tool output and conversation history to a few sentences, freeing context for the actual task; continues in a fresh session automatically.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit
entry.summary: Auto-sends continue when a local model hits its output-token cap: dual-source detection (turn-max-tokens node + provider response), maxConsecutive guard (default 3) prevents infinite loops.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-memory
entry.summary: Project-level and global long-term memory for DSH Web: isolated POST /items route to avoid path conflicts, multi-turn tool-call context compression before storing entries, deduplication and session-persistent storage.

entry.title: zilliztech/memsearch
entry.summary: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and a review panel.

entry.title: nousag/dsh-writing-desk
entry.summary: Local-first writing workbench: book/volume/chapter management, draft editor, note reference, word count and export.

entry.title: taxueseek/dsh-plugin-guard
entry.summary: Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.

entry.title: taxueseek/dsh-snippets
entry.summary: Minimal snippet and command toolbox for DSH: five tools over a single human-editable JSONL file, zero UI, zero database, zero network, explicit save-only memory.

entry.title: taxue-dsh-artisan
entry.summary: Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.

entry.title: zilliztech/dsh-milvus
entry.summary: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.

entry.title: taxueseek/dsh-healthcheck
entry.summary: Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.

entry.title: beijingwahw/dsh-nuke-plugin
entry.summary: Transactional uninstall engine: every destructive action runs a validate/preview/execute/undo four-phase pipeline with Saga rollback, WAL crash self-recovery, hash-chain audit trail, hard-link dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before committing.

entry.title: exoticknight/dsh-labnana
entry.summary: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing, with credits estimation and web settings UI.

entry.title: mjylfz/dsh-skill-mover
entry.summary: One-click migration of skills from other agents into DeepSeek Harness: 14 platform detectors plus shared-layer recognition, same-name skill merging, no re-copying of existing skills, and rollback support.

entry.title: Nicholas023/vision-exp-tile
entry.summary: Large-image recognition for vision models: 800×800 lossless tiling (smart/pipeline/full strategies) plus local OCR (auto inversion/binarization/handwriting split) and optional multi-vendor GPU acceleration (DirectML covering NVIDIA/AMD/Intel, CUDA/OpenVINO) with automatic CPU fallback; MIT licensed (111 unit tests).

entry.title: xiajiajun516/dsh-config-manager
entry.summary: Full DSH configuration backup, restore, export, import, migrate and sync: settings, providers, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and workspaces in one ZIP, with encrypted backups, Git/WebDAV sync and a configuration marketplace.

entry.title: Abel-86/task-chime
entry.summary: Plays local sounds for approval/permission requests and task completion, configurable from the Web GUI settings.

entry.title: AgentsDanceAI/dsh-plugin-cloud
entry.summary: Connect to the DSH Cloud gateway (hosted or self-hosted): device-authorization login, and one command writes multi-provider models (DeepSeek / GPT / Claude / Gemini and 20 more) into the user config layer.

entry.title: chenzhi-clude/dsh-hooks-pack
entry.summary: One-click Claude Code & Codex hooks: auto-discovers your existing ~/.claude / ~/.codex hook config and runs it on the official bridge plugins, with an explicit sandbox-policy shim so hook commands never die silently.

entry.title: bunipai/dsh-fare-meter
entry.summary: Taxi-meter style real-time cost: ticks every half second while generating, resets when idle, with official peak/valley pricing built in.

entry.title: whateverboy2333/dsh-flat-teams
entry.summary: Leaderless flat agent teams: cross-window structured task dispatch (state machine + event stream + offline resume), a read-only progress recorder, and a two-level web dashboard.
